newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian STB bank has higher '96 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian STB bank has higher '96 net profit.

text.p: Societe Tunisienne de Banques, the second largest bank in Tunisia, made a 16.562 million dinars net profit in 1996, up from 15.625 million dinars in 1995, results showed on Thursday.
The state-controlled bank said it would distribute a 0.5 dinar dividend per share starting of June 16.
Its total balance sheet amounted to 2.350 billion dinars in 1996, compared to 2.189 billion dinars in 1995. Turnover was 163.366 million dinars up from 141.480 million dinars in 1995.
STB has a capital of 80 million dinars. It is listed at the Tunis Stock Exchange. ($=1.0981 dinar)
